mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS ( email, password_hash, nickname, role, default_region_level1, default_region_level2, default_age, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, COALESCE(#{role}, 'ROLE_USER'), #{defaultRegionLevel1, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{defaultRegionLevel2, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{defaultAge, jdbcType=INTEGER}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, email, password_hash, nickname, role, default_region_level1, default_region_level2, default_age, created_at, updated_at FROM USERS WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT user_id, email, password_hash, nickname, role, default_region_level1, default_region_level2, default_age, created_at, updated_at FROM USERS WHERE user_id = #{userId}
